title: Sieve has_terminal flag logic spread across 40 lines without invariant comment
description: sieve/src/lib.rs:50-94: has_terminal tracks whether the script produced a disposition (Keep/Discard/FileInto/Reject). The logic is spread across ~40 lines of match arms. A contributor who adds a new Action variant and forgets to set has_terminal=true will silently add an implicit Keep after their action. Fix: add a module-level comment: 'has_terminal must be set true for any action that constitutes a final disposition per RFC 5228 §4.1; if false after all events, implicit Keep is inserted.' Consider using an exhaustive match or enum with disposition marker.
